The '''Battle of Mikaster III''' was a battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mikaster III]]. During the battle, [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droids]] released deadly [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] against the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
